title: Lamb Biryani
description: A popular Indian dish made with lamb, rice, and spices. This recipe yields a flavorful and aromatic biryani with tender lamb and fluffy rice.
instructions: Heat the clarified butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until it is lightly browned.
Add the grated ginger and sauté for another minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the coriander powder, red chili powder, and salt. Mix well.
Add 2 cups of water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is cooking, heat the clarified butter in a separate saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until it is lightly browned.
Add the basmati rice and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
To assemble the biryani, layer the cooked lamb mixture and rice mixture in a large saucepan.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
